entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_01
entries.text: A sandwich with just ham and butter in it. So simple that\nthere’s no way to fake it.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_02
entries.text: A Jambon-Beurre with a bitter twist. If you love a touch of\nbitterness, you’ll want to eat this.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_03
entries.text: A Jambon-Beurre with a sweet twist. Seeking the finest\nsweetness around? Look no further.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_04
entries.text: A Jambon-Beurre with a salty twist. Packs a delicious\nsalty punch.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_05
entries.text: A Jambon-Beurre with a sour twist. Its vivid acidic notes\nwill leave you wanting another.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_06
entries.text: A Jambon-Beurre with a spicy twist. If you like a sandwich\nwith some kick to it, don’t miss this.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_07
entries.text: A sandwich known as the ultimate in bitter taste. The herbs\nshould be laid on thick.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_08
entries.text: A sandwich for the true salt aficionado. When eating this,\nmake absolutely certain to have a drink at hand.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_09
entries.text: A sandwich so sweet it’s downright frightening. The trick is\nto really pile on the herbs.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_10
entries.text: A sandwich devoted to true fans of sour flavors.\nThe fresher the herbs, the more potent the sourness.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_11
entries.text: A sandwich so spicy it practically assaults the tongue.\nDislikers of spicy food, beware.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_12
entries.text: A sandwich made with only jam and slices of strawberry.\nThe simplicity of this dish is what makes it so appetizing.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_13
entries.text: The addition of yogurt has heightened the sweetness and\ndeepened the richness of this sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_14
entries.text: Filling enough to be a meal, tasty enough to be a snack.\nIt’s best when you choose the sweetest pineapples.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_15
entries.text: A truly perfected sandwich, with the addition of the herbs\nelevating all the other fillings.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_16
entries.text: Peanut butter and bananas make a surprisingly nice pair.\nThey leave you feeling full and satisfied.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_17
entries.text: Adding butter into the mix has contributed yet more\nsubstance, making this one robust sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_18
entries.text: The jam adds a new note of sweetness, making this\nsandwich yet more filling.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_19
entries.text: The daring addition of bold spice has made this sandwich\nstrangely addicting.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_20
entries.text: This sandwich keeps it profoundly simple. It’s best when\nyou don’t skimp on the olive oil.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_21
entries.text: The sourness of the pickles pairs with the fresh taste of the\nwatercress for a sandwich as refreshing as a light breeze.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_22
entries.text: The fragrant basil draws out new depths of flavor from this\nsandwich’s fillings.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_23
entries.text: The hit of sourness from the added herbs will leave you\nwanting more of this simple yet satisfying sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_24
entries.text: A simple, economical, and tasty sandwich. Toasting it for\nextra flavor is also good.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_25
entries.text: The sweetness of the butter highlights the sourness.\nBut add too much butter, and you’ll spoil the overall flavor.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_26
entries.text: The stronger the marmalade’s sourness, the better.\nThis sandwich is particularly appealing.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_27
entries.text: The finishing touch of saltiness is the clincher.\nThis sandwich’s exquisite balance of flavor brings it to life.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_28
entries.text: Sausage with fragrant herbs meets ketchup in this sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_29
entries.text: The sour bite and spiciness of the mustard takes this\nsandwich to the next level.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_30
entries.text: This sandwich boasts fresh vegetables and sausage—\na faultless combo.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_31
entries.text: A sandwich with a tried-and-true type of tastiness.\nThe bitter flavor really ties all the fillings together.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_32
entries.text: A tricky proposition of a sandwich. You might try lightly\ntoasting the curry powder.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_33
entries.text: The spicy kick added to this sandwich has made it\nmore palatable, but it may still be an acquired taste.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_34
entries.text: With tasty tomatoes, this sandwich is more approachable\nthan ever—and yet it remains an acquired taste.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_35
entries.text: A sandwich of intense, provocative spiciness. For all the\nadded ingredients, it remains an adventurous choice.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_36
entries.text: This sandwich is just the thing for dessert time. The yogurt\nis on the sweeter side.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_37
entries.text: The addition of vibrant green kiwi makes this sandwich\nas pleasing to the eye as to the palate.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_38
entries.text: A sandwich with a lovely trio of fruits. It’s a winner when\nserved slightly chilled.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_39
entries.text: The Dessert Sandwich’s ultimate form. Just a hint of herbs\nwill do the trick.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_40
entries.text: The balance of acidity and umami is key. A touch of extra\nmarmalade is the trick to making it special.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_41
entries.text: The pineapple unlocks the tropical atmosphere. The more\nthe sourness comes through, the tastier the sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_42
entries.text: A sandwich with an unfamiliar twist. The added spiciness\nbrings depth to the flavors.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_43
entries.text: A sandwich befitting the “tropical” label. The herbs bring\nthe flavors into tight unison.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_44
entries.text: The flavor of this sandwich changes depending on the\nripeness of the avocado. One never tires of eating this one.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_45
entries.text: A sandwich with a firm flavor profile. With fillings so widely\nbeloved, it’s a sure hit.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_46
entries.text: A solidly delicious sandwich. It’s impossible to go wrong\nwith these fillings—this is flavor you can depend on.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_47
entries.text: The steadfast sandwich in its ultimate form. The salt works\nits magic, making for a profoundly tasty sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_48
entries.text: When exactly did this sandwich rise to fame? Where did\nthe recipe even come from? Mysteries abound.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_49
entries.text: A nice, filling sandwich. The addition of lettuce makes it\nmore approachable.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_50
entries.text: This sandwich will fill you up like few others do.\nThe richness of the chorizo works wonders.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_51
entries.text: The touch of bitterness tugs at the appetite. This is one\nsolid, substantial sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_52
entries.text: A veggie-forward, filling sandwich. How tasty it ends up\nbeing depends entirely on the quality of the potato salad.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_53
entries.text: The veggies are the star players of this satisfying sandwich.\nTasty even if the avocado is still a tad firm.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_54
entries.text: A sandwich boasting a plethora of different vegetables.\nConnoisseurs prefer generous amounts of seasoning.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_55
entries.text: The ultimate form of the Potato Salad Sandwich.\nThe sweetness of the herbs hugely affects its flavor.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_56
entries.text: The spiciness of the sauce brings the sweetness of the\nveggies to life in this sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_57
entries.text: The bitterness of this sandwich’s green bell peppers goes\nperfectly with the spicy sauce.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_58
entries.text: A sandwich packing a nice dose of veggies, whose savory\nsides are brought out by the spicy sauce.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_59
entries.text: A sandwich with such a fine ratio of spiciness to sourness\nthat you’ll just keep reaching for more.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_60
entries.text: A sandwich with pleasingly straightforward flavors.\nThe fundamental taste of the egg gets to shine.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_61
entries.text: The crunch and sweetness of the onion brings out the\nrichness of the egg.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_62
entries.text: For those who’ve gotten tired of the plain and simple Egg\nSandwich. The egg and the cheese pair beautifully.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_63
entries.text: The fully realized Egg Sandwich. Robust saltiness is its\nstandout feature.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_64
entries.text: A sandwich with potent fillings. Young people in particular\nappreciate how substantial it is.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_65
entries.text: The spicy flavor gives this sandwich a comforting feel.\nEspecially tasty when the potato tortilla is piping hot.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_66
entries.text: A sandwich that won’t leave you hungry. Well-ripened\navocados are better for this one.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_67
entries.text: A deeply substantial sandwich. The bitterness brings\nharmony to the flavors.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_68
entries.text: This sandwich feels like a cousin to a salad. The more\ntomatoes, the better.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_69
entries.text: A fruit-forward sandwich. The kiwi’s sourness does it plenty\nof favors.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_70
entries.text: This sandwich may only have fruits and veggies in it, but it’s\ntasty no matter how into veggies you are—or aren’t.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_71
entries.text: The spicy addition to the sandwich’s mostly sour fillings\nand condiments creates a tantalizing flavor.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_72
entries.text: A tried and true sandwich. You can’t go wrong with these\nclassic, ordinary flavors.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_73
entries.text: Adding basil lends a bit of a rich air to this BLT Sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_74
entries.text: The cheese makes for a more filling experience. The flavors\nof this sandwich are in perfect balance.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_75
entries.text: A hint of sweetness manages to preserve the harmony\nbetween all the fillings of this miraculous sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_76
entries.text: The potato salad plays an important part in counteracting\nthe oiliness of the fried fillet.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_77
entries.text: The fresh crunch of the lettuce matches exceptionally well\nwith this sandwich’s fried fillet.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_78
entries.text: The horseradish’s invigorating spiciness helps make this\na very inviting sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_79
entries.text: This is the ultimate expression of the Fried Fillet\nSandwich. The spicy kick makes it an absolute pleasure.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_80
entries.text: This sandwich is the embodiment of cheap and tasty.\nIt tastes best when mayonnaise is applied generously.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_81
entries.text: A sandwich boasting two different types of ham. A little\nrich, perhaps, but plenty tasty.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_82
entries.text: The stimulating spiciness of the jalapeño draws out the\nsavoriness of the ham.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_83
entries.text: The ultimate Ham Sandwich, with a saltiness that caresses\nthe taste buds. More ham, more happy.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_84
entries.text: A sandwich for the cheese lover. The simple seasonings\nmake this a welcoming bite.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_85
entries.text: A sandwich that will certainly fill you up. It’s tastiest when\nthe avocado is just a tad firm.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_86
entries.text: The fragrance of the basil in this sandwich activates the\nappetite. Using plenty of pepper balances the flavors well.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_87
entries.text: The strong note of salt in this sandwich makes the richness\nand savoriness of the cheese shine through.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_88
entries.text: The hamburger patty is the heart and soul of this sandwich,\nbut the vinegar’s acidic note is what sets it apart.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_89
entries.text: The hamburger patty is the heart and soul of this sandwich,\nbut the horseradish’s spicy kick is what sets it apart.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_90
entries.text: The hamburger patty is the heart and soul of this sandwich,\nbut the watercress’s bitter taste is what sets it apart.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_91
entries.text: The hamburger patty is the heart and soul of this sandwich,\nbut the herbs’ sweetness is what sets it apart.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_92
entries.text: A sandwich with a sophisticated flavor. Nailing the balance\nbetween the condiments is crucial.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_93
entries.text: A sandwich with a refreshing flavor. It’s tastier if you don’t\ngo overboard on the vegetables.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_94
entries.text: A sandwich with a refined flavor. The fragrant basil goes\nwell with the smoked fillet.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_95
entries.text: This sandwich is rumored in some circles to unequivocally\nbe the best way to eat smoked fillet.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_96
entries.text: Full of fruit. The sophisticated approach is to go easy on\nthe cream and let the ingredients speak for themselves.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_97
entries.text: This sandwich feels akin to a treat. Just a hint of marmalade\nis ideal.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_98
entries.text: This sandwich feels quite dessert-like. It’s best when you\ndon’t go overboard on the yogurt.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_99
entries.text: A sandwich whose flavors positively sing. It’s best when you\ndon’t go overboard on the herbs.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_100
entries.text: A sandwich with a range of flavors to enjoy. The fillings can\nbe in whatever proportions you like.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_101
entries.text: A sandwich popular with younger folks. The potato salad\nleaves you pleasantly full.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_102
entries.text: The addition of hamburger brings more heft. Younger folks\ntend to like this with plenty of condiments.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_103
entries.text: A connoisseur’s sandwich, with the fillings tied together by\na supreme note of bitterness.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_104
entries.text: A sandwich that fills you up well without being too heavy.\nIdeal for those in search of a light meal.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_105
entries.text: A sandwich for the somewhat mature palate, with an\naddictively spicy note from the sauce.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_106
entries.text: A sandwich that spares no detail. The crunch of the bell\npepper provides a lovely accent.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_107
entries.text: This sandwich’s savory flavors stand out even more boldly\nthanks to the boost of spiciness.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_108
entries.text: It’s a close cousin to the Fruit Sandwich, but the butter sets\nthis one apart.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_109
entries.text: The pinch of salt serves to tease out the sweetness of this\nsandwich’s fillings.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_110
entries.text: The basil’s light touch of bitter flavor helps bring this\nsandwich’s other fillings to life.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_111
entries.text: A sandwich with a subtle note of sourness. The slightest\namount of herbs is all that’s needed.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_112
entries.text: A juicy, vegetable-laden sandwich. The fresher the veggies,\nthe tastier the dish.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_113
entries.text: A sandwich featuring an all-veggie lineup of fillings.\nThe condiments play a major role in the overall flavor.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_114
entries.text: Veggies are this sandwich’s bread and butter, so to speak.\nAdding plenty of watercress firms up the flavor.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_115
entries.text: The fully realized all-veggie sandwich. The overall quality\ndepends hugely on how thickly you lay on the herbs.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_116
entries.text: A sandwich that only has time for the ingredients that’ll fill\nyou up the best.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_117
entries.text: A sandwich whose main goal is filling up the tummy.\nIt’s got a nice flavor, but the focus here is quantity.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_118
entries.text: A sandwich devoted to the cause of filling up the tummy.\nEaters should know what they’re getting into.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_119
entries.text: A bright acidic note makes this sandwich a pleasure to eat,\nthough it doesn’t change the impact of the sheer volume.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_120
entries.text: As the name suggests, this sandwich packs a bit of heat.\nEnjoying these veggies is a mark of grown-up taste.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_121
entries.text: Achieving proper balance between the condiments is\ndelicate work. The fragrance of basil whets the appetite.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_122
entries.text: This sandwich has become yet spicier and more appealing\nto grown-up tastes. It’s not necessarily for everyone.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_123
entries.text: This sandwich is spicy to the core. If you’re not seeking\nsuch stimulation, it may not be for you.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_124
entries.text: A vegetable-centric sandwich whose sauce delivers a\nparticular shocking kick.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_125
entries.text: This sandwich boasts an all-star vegetable cast. It’s best to\neat it immediately after the cucumber has been added.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_126
entries.text: A sandwich one can proudly offer to a veggie lover. Use\njust enough mayonnaise to provide a little flavor accent.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_127
entries.text: Veggies are this sandwich’s sole purpose. Adding a touch\nof sweet makes the veggies’ natural savoriness stand out.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_128
entries.text: A sandwich that pairs the sweetness of butter with the spicy\nkick of horseradish.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_129
entries.text: The richness of the avocado shines in this sandwich.\nThe balance between the fruits is key to making it tasty.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_130
entries.text: This sandwich walks a tightrope between sweet and spicy.\nTastiest when the cheese is abundant.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_131
entries.text: The hint of bitterness in this sandwich creates a new\nharmony between the spicy and sweet flavors.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_132
entries.text: This sandwich’s fillings speak for themselves—loudly—\nso it’s tastiest when you go light on the condiments.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_133
entries.text: This sandwich uses truly precious and fine ingredients.\nThe tofu lends it more substance.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_134
entries.text: Achieving balance between these ingredients is no easy\nfeat. Tastiest when the seasonings are piled on a bit.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_135
entries.text: Adding the ultimate in spiciness makes this sandwich of\ndistinct, vibrant ingredients into a unified masterpiece.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_136
entries.text: A sandwich designed by and for tofu lovers. It will never\nleave you hungry.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_137
entries.text: This sandwich is not the easiest to pull off. Be sure to drain\nthe tofu thoroughly.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_138
entries.text: The simple flavor of the tofu and the bitterness of the\nwatercress make for a strangely appealing match.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_139
entries.text: The precious herbs’ saltiness makes the tofu’s savory notes\nshine through.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_140
entries.text: While others ask “why?” this sandwich asks, “why not?”\nIt’s best when the curry powder is lightly toasted.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_141
entries.text: The eye-widening spiciness of the jalapeño heightens the\ncurry flavor.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_142
entries.text: The eggs provide a mellow coating over the spicy\nflavors beneath.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_143
entries.text: The faint sweetness perfects the taste, bringing new depth\nand richness to the sandwich.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_144
entries.text: To this sandwich, the righteous path lies in sheer quantity.\nIt’s downright aggressive in its effort to fill you up.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_145
entries.text: This sandwich prioritizes filling you up first and foremost.\nIt’s not particularly concerned with flavor.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_146
entries.text: A sandwich concerned only with volume. It can be tasty,\ntoo, depending on the seasonings.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_147
entries.text: Thanks to the magic of spice, this ultra-voluminous\nsandwich even manages to taste rather good.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_148
entries.text: A sandwich that aspires to be sushi. Are you surprised at\nhow tasty it is? Good—that’s the idea.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_149
entries.text: A sandwich made with a love of sushi foremost in the mind.\nThe bitterness of the watercress works well here.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_150
entries.text: A sandwich dreamed up by a sushi aficionado. The sheer\namount of sandwich going on here is part of the appeal.

entries.label: pokepicnic_cookinfo_01_151
entries.text: The ultimate form of the Sushi Sandwich. The refreshing\nsourness elevates this sandwich to masterpiece level.
